cases.headline: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
cases.summary: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent. Uncertainty about the economic outlook has diminished but remains elevated.

cases.headline: Apple reports fiscal quarterly results
cases.summary: The Company posted quarterly revenue of $85.8 billion, up 5 percent year over year, and quarterly earnings per diluted share of $1.40, up 11 percent year over year.
